title: 1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_1LE---: 400 more stages of two chain laws, to about 10^409 steps
text: Each time a carry leaves the right chain, the turning cell of 1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_1LE--- moves, and the tape around the new cell is again a base-3 chain on the left and a binary chain on the right, with other gifts per visit. A simulator that fits those gifts per stage and checks them on cell-by-cell runs follows 400 stages from blank tape, about 10<sup>409</sup> steps, with no halt and 0 mismatches in 18,882 self-checks.
